Most points lie on x=0.5 or y=0.5, creating many parallel and orthogonal alignments. This forces the minimum area triangles to be very thin right triangles along the grid axes. The most constrained triangles are formed by (0.5, 0.25), (0.25, 0.5), and (0.25, 0.25), which form a right triangle with legs of length 0.25. The area is 0.5 * 0.25 * 0.25 = 0.03125. All 286 triangles have an area of at least 0.03125 because the minimum vertical and horizontal spacing between non-identical points is 0.25, and no two points share both coordinates, preventing any area from dropping below this threshold.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
